title: comprisk: A scikit-learn-compatible Python toolkit for competing-risks survival analysis
abstract: arXiv:2607.09431v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Medical time-to-event data are frequently subject to competing risks, where the occurrence of one terminal event precludes the others and standard survival methods that treat competing events as censoring yield biased absolute-risk estimates. Valid analysis instead targets the cause-specific cumulative incidence function (CIF). This methodology has been available to applied researchers almost exclusively through R packages, forcing Python-based machine-learning workflows into a Python-to-R round trip. We present comprisk, a scikit-learn-compatible Python toolkit that puts the canonical competing-risks methods behind one API: a scalable competing-risks random survival forest, Fine-Gray subdistribution-hazard regression and a penalized variant, cause-specific Cox regression, the Aalen-Johansen CIF estimator, and Gray's K-sample test, together with competing-risks-aware model evaluation. translated_title: comprisk：一个兼容scikit-learn的Python工具包，用于竞争风险生存分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.09431v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：医学时间至事件数据经常受到竞争风险的影响，其中一个终末事件的发生会阻止其他事件的发生，而将竞争事件视为删失的标准生存方法会产生有偏的绝对风险估计。有效的分析应针对特定原因的累积发生率函数（CIF）。这一方法学几乎仅通过R包提供给应用研究人员，迫使基于Python的机器学习工作流程进行Python到R的往返转换。我们提出了comprisk，一个兼容scikit-learn的Python工具包，将经典的竞争风险方法整合到一个API之后：可扩展的竞争风险随机生存森林、Fine-Gray亚分布风险回归及其惩罚变体、特定原因Cox回归、Aalen-Johansen CIF估计器、Gray的K样本检验，以及竞争风险感知的模型评估。每个估计器都经过数值验证。
tldr: 本文介绍了comprisk，一个Python工具包，首次将竞争风险生存分析的关键方法（如Fine-Gray回归和随机生存森林）集成到scikit-learn兼容接口中，消除了Python用户依赖R包进行此类分析的需求。
en_tdlr: This paper presents comprisk, a Python toolkit that integrates key competing-risks survival analysis methods, such as Fine-Gray regression and random survival forests, into a scikit-learn-compatible interface, eliminating the need for Python users to rely on R packages for such analyses.
